failure_modes: Time-conditioned attention edit (C008-C011) would modulate regional weights on sign-conflicting landmark contrasts, displacing surrounding coordinates without validated affinity benefit.

Dose-only edit (C001-C003) changes pointcloud_delta_A away from the incumbent default with no evidence of expected advantage, risking larger endpoint displacement under the same detached Hungarian matching.

Teacher-count edit (C005-C007) alters the nearest-k prior without evidence that a different k improves final predicted affinity; selection-node enrichment is not descendant survival or terminal affinity credit.
Interpreting the reported first/last rate z-values as a spatial gradient direction would mis-specify the reward, since the temporal derivative is not a coordinate gradient.
rationale: D1.2: The offered time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009-C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention at observed score nodes using the same static teachers; they are coordinate rewards, not velocity forces, and the temporal derivative in the trend table is not a spatial gradient. Analyst's temporal evidence is descriptive only: the inspected landmark contrasts show 4-10 sign changes and 1-9 strong sign conflicts with extrapolation disallowed, and whole-window z-values are small and mixed in sign, so no time-conditioned rule is validated against a stationary coordinate target. D4.1: The incumbent (pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, static program D2_without_trajectory_static) already sits at the default delta and a mid-range neighbor count; the offered edits are either dose-only (C001-C003 pointcloud_delta_A) or attention/teacher-count changes (C004-C007) with no supplied evidence of expected advantage over the incumbent. D4.2: The predicted failure of a time-conditioned or larger-dose edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the regional recipe uses a detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention with positive surrounding weight, so amplifying or time-modulating attention would pull neighboring coordinates even where the landmark contrast is sign-conflicting, and the affinity-first priority is not served because no decoded terminal labels or outcome data show affinity benefit. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the defensible choice; deferring is also valid but retain preserves the declared bindings.
